answer: Each agent posts a 70-credit bond and files a behavior fingerprint — its wharf rhythm of dune crossings and idle gaps. Each epoch it replays a fresh slice against the wharf fable's cadence. Rented fingerprints fail: reused rhythms burn both bonds. Filing starts at 38, plus 6 per identity; the 1,000th pays 6,032. Forging 1,000 costs 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked, against 40,000 in rewards. An honest agent pays 38 once and keeps its bond.
